title: Organization member-list draft, org-authority-draft/1 (DEC-0131)
description: What an organization server serves at GET {issuer}/fabric/membership/v1/{org}/authority/draft (DEC-0131 OX-6): the next org-authority/1 it drafted, unsigned, for an administrator's passkey to sign. docs/specification/membership.md.

org.description: The organization the draft is for; the draft names the same (FAC-SEM-151).

base.description: The last signed document the draft was made from, by revision and digest, or null for the first. The draft's revision is one above it (FAC-SEM-151).

draft.description: An org-authority/1 without digest and signature: every member an administrator's passkey signs over, exactly.

digest.description: The draft's digest: SHA-256 of what its signer signs over it (FAC-SEM-151). The server accepts a signed document only when its signed bytes have this digest.
